name: Nasal dilator / strips

lead: Nasal strips and internal dilators are adhesive or insert devices that hold the nostrils open. They are used for congestion, sleep and snoring.
In looksmaxxing circles they are sometimes confused with jaw or face development; they only affect airflow in the moment and do not change facial structure.

paras: A spring-like strip across the nose lifts the nasal side walls and stiffens the nasal valve, lowering airflow resistance while worn.

Side effects are mostly adhesive skin irritation. A systematic review found no significant change in apnoea-hypopnoea index or snoring index in sleep apnoea, so they are not a treatment for it. Benefits for congestion or snoring in non-apnoea users are mostly subjective.
